name: swarming-physics
description: WebAssembly Barnes-Hut 3D force simulation for swarming graph visualization

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --release && node -e "for(const f of ['.gitignore','package.json','README.md','LICENSE'])require('fs').rmSync('pkg/'+f,{force:true})"
scripts.build:bundler: wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg --release && node -e "for(const f of ['.gitignore','package.json','README.md','LICENSE'])require('fs').rmSync('pkg/'+f,{force:true})"
scripts.build:nodejs: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg --release && node -e "for(const f of ['.gitignore','package.json','README.md','LICENSE'])require('fs').rmSync('pkg/'+f,{force:true})"
